blocks.text: Histograms are used to show the distribution of a dataset. They group data into bins or intervals, allowing you to see how frequently values occur within those ranges.
Example: If you want to analyze how students performed in an math exam, a histogram can show the distribution of scores.

blocks.alt: Histogram titled Maths Test Results. Test Scores bins 50-55 to 96-100 with frequencies 1, 2, 5, 4, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3 and 2.
